rollups.text: Board games and gaming: Ticket to Ride was played with cousins using the US map expansion at the user's uncle's New Year's Eve celebration on 2022-12-31; the user won for the first time by completing New York–Los Angeles. The user was considering Trains (base game with Simple deck), TransAmerica, and Train Station for a 4–5-person friends' game night. The user's girlfriend enjoyed Carcassonne, and the user was considering Azul and Qwirkle to play with her. The user had played Magic: The Gathering extensively in high school and was considering returning after seeing an advertisement for a new set. For family game night, the user's niece might enjoy Forbidden Island or Unstable Unicorns.

Photography equipment and software: The user owns a Canon EOS 80D and has taken it on trips involving Yellowstone, Yosemite, and the Grand Canyon; by 2023-05-30, the user said the camera had been on five trips. The user had a Lowepro backpack-style camera bag by 2023-03-16, and later considered the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW for carrying all their gear; purchase of the latter was not confirmed. The user was considering a Really Right Stuff tripod, including the TVC-34L on 2023-03-16, but had not confirmed a purchase. The user planned to invest in a Lee Filters square-filter system, starting with a soft graduated ND filter, and had recently bought a camera strap by 2023-05-30. The user decided to use Adobe Creative Cloud, Lightroom, and Photoshop for professional photography and Google Photos for personal photos, and had been meaning to replace the cap for their 18-135mm kit lens.

Travel interests and proposed trips: The user has expressed interest in trekking in the Himalayas, especially the Annapurna Circuit, for its culture and scenery; no trip was booked. On 2023-03-23, the user considered a Pacific Northwest RV road trip and an Oregon Coast Highway drive from Tillamook to Bandon, including the Three Capes Scenic Drive and Cape Kiwanda; this remained a prospective plan. On 2023-05-07, the user asked about visiting Asturias, Spain, including transport, car rental, weather, restaurants, trip length, airport transfers, mopeds, and walking tours; no dates or bookings were stated. A six-day Banff itinerary for 2023-06-14 through 2023-06-19, including vegetarian dinners and excursions to Lake Louise, the Icefields Parkway, and Yoho National Park, was proposed but not confirmed as booked. The user planned a Zion National Park photography trip on 2023-05-30.

YouTube cooking and live-streaming development: The user began live streaming on YouTube in early January 2023; by 2023-03-01, Q&A sessions and cooking demonstrations were going well. A joint stream with a fellow travel vlogger on 2023-02-07 was described as successful. On 2023-02-26, the user described their content as cooking and audience interaction, including Q&As and tutorials, and planned a kitchen tour and meal-prep content. By 2023-03-01, the user was considering more cooking demonstration streams and creator collaborations, including a possible beginner-cooking stream with a popular cooking YouTuber; no collaboration was secured.

Morning routine and yoga: On 2023-02-23, the user was trying to establish a consistent sleep schedule and weekday morning routine, usually having coffee around 8:00 a.m. while checking email and considering adding exercise. The user planned to begin 10-minute yoga sessions at 8:00 a.m. three times weekly starting 2023-02-24, before coffee and email, with an earlier alarm and bedtime and a forgiving approach to missed days. The user planned to follow Yoga with Adriene and start with gentle Hatha or Yin yoga, and intended to buy a good-quality mat before adding optional props. The records describe a plan; they do not confirm that the routine began.

Running and route planning: On 2023-03-05, the user reported that switching from Brooks Ghost 13 to Asics Gel-Kayano 28 shoes significantly reduced knee pain, and planned to look for running socks and follow shoe-care guidance. The user had been running mainly on a lake trail and was bored with the scenery. They planned to seek route recommendations and try a nearby park route for a longer run on the weekend of 2023-03-11–2023-03-12, starting slowly and attending to pacing, fueling, and hydration. The user later completed a charity bike ride on 2023-05-19 and expressed interest in scenic, paved, roughly 20-mile cycling routes that avoid very hilly terrain; they planned to try Strava and MapMyRide, starting with Strava Route Builder. These are related outdoor-fitness interests, but the records do not confirm that the planned routes or app use occurred.

Books, magazines, and literary events: In January 2023, the user attended a Rachel Smith reading at the local library and asked a question during the Q&A; in February 2023, the user attended another library event where Smith discussed her novel The Lost City. On 2023-03-05, the user said they enjoyed novels with strong female leads and asked about Naomi Alderman's The Power. The user expressed interest in more readings and festivals and looked forward to a launch event for The Art of Falling, though the stated event date preceded the conversation date. On 2023-06-06, the user said they enjoyed The New Yorker and had recently started The Economist, set aside Sundays for reading with coffee, was interested in The Atlantic's politics and policy coverage and special reports, and preferred physical magazines. The user was considering an Atlantic subscription but had not decided.

Digital-marketing career development: The user has a bachelor's degree in Business Administration with a Marketing concentration from the University of California, Berkeley, and works in digital marketing, usually 40 hours weekly and sometimes up to 50 during peak campaigns. On 2023-03-28, the user wanted to strengthen content creation and strategy skills, said the HubSpot Content Marketing Certification might fit their schedule, and considered the more time-intensive Coursera Digital Marketing Specialization. The user was considering a transition into Content Marketing Strategist or Digital Marketing Consultant work, professional CDMP or CMP certification, and possibly an MBA; no enrollment or decision was confirmed.

BIM/CAD/CAM consultancy plans: In Q2 2023, the user planned to start a consultancy advising small-to-medium-sized manufacturers and architecture, engineering, and construction businesses on implementing BIM, CAD, and CAM processes. On 2023-05-30, the user described the idea as a business addressing companies' digitalization needs and asked about existing competitors and the viability of the opportunity. The user said the plan was expected to be pursued in a couple of months and asked that it be considered in future self-development advice. No business launch is confirmed.

Smart Village Project proposal: On 2023-03-13, the user repeatedly asked to continue a proposal for sustainable and ecological agriculture in Ukraine. The proposal included organic fertilizer made from agricultural waste, German technology and European expertise, pilot areas, farmer and cooperative partnerships, concentrated proteins from oilseed meal and cake, a Ukrainian Agroholding, a European Agro-Mini Academy, and an agro-laboratory. Proposed phases were planning and feasibility, resources and training, implementation, and monitoring and evaluation, with a 20-person team and listed agricultural and classroom resources in a five-year version. The assistant gave changing estimates: $3.5 million over about three years; a detailed $3.35 million budget; then a five-year $5 million estimate whose phase allocations actually summed to $5.75 million. These were proposal drafts, not evidence of an implemented project.

The user had never received a flu shot as of 2023-03-15. After discussing risks and benefits, the user planned to contact their doctor during 2023 about getting vaccinated and finding a location; the records do not confirm vaccination occurred.

Jewelry care and security: Around 2023-02-08, the user had their engagement ring cleaned and inspected at a jewelry store near work; the store tightened its prongs, and the ring looked sparkling and like new afterward. On 2023-02-22, the user was considering a new appraisal and insurance for the ring and an appraisal and insurance for their mother's pearl necklace. The user was also concerned about apartment-building security and considered a jewelry armoire or other more secure valuables storage; no appraisal, insurance, or storage purchase was confirmed.

Instagram charity campaign: On 2023-03-24, the user said an Instagram campaign for an unnamed favorite charity was doing well and considered further collaboration. The user was interested in Hootsuite Insights and Agorapulse, considered sharing lessons on LinkedIn, and contemplated a photo contest asking participants to share stories about the charity, potentially using a hashtag and featuring the winner on the charity's page or website. No post, contest, or collaboration was confirmed.

Creative arts and portfolio: On 2023-05-30, the user said they had resumed painting after a five-year break and had been painting again for a few months, enjoying it and exploring abstract art. The user planned to start a Behance portfolio, possibly posting abstract paintings first, and to create an emotion-inspired series beginning with a calmness painting using soft blue, blending or glazing, and organic forms. The user was considering organizing Behance work into separate projects by style, theme, or series, but had not decided.

The user's family had a large restaurant celebration for the user's sister's engagement on the weekend of 2023-02-25–2023-02-26. On 2023-03-05, the user said the engagement had brought the family closer and was prioritizing time with their niece and cousins. The user's mother was helping with cooking for a planned family game night and had begun discussing a possible summer wedding with the sister and her fiancé. The user also attended a cousin's son's high-school graduation gathering planned for approximately 2023-04-13–2023-04-19 and decided to make a graduation-cap cake as a dessert-board centerpiece.
